text: I am in the same situation. It's not just your brain and willpower, your digestive system has a lot of sway over the brain, and can make it seem like the brain had the idea to eat something that was not entirely healthy. But deprivation does have a psychological effect. It is not easy. I bought one of those special scales that measure fat and muscle in addition to weight, and it helps. It isn't the kilograms, but the tissue that makes the kilograms. Please take care of yourself.❤
